what: Pressing the three-line burger (top 16px · middle 16px · bottom 10px, 7px gaps) steps through .25s linear keyframes into an X — until 35% the middle line fades out while the top and bottom lines stay put, and at 65% the top and bottom lines gather to the center, stretch to 20px and bend to ±45°. Pressing again plays the same steps in reverse back to the burger. Each press fires fx:open · fx:close to open and close the drawer

options.dur: Duration of one change (sec), default .25 — 0 means instant
options.--fx-w · --fx-w2 · --fx-x: Line length (css): top and middle default 16px · bottom 10px · 20px when X
options.[data-fx-part=line]: Middle line (one child) — the top and bottom lines are drawn with its ::before·::after. The color is the button text color (currentColor)
options.fx:open · fx:close: Fired from the element when it opens and closes (bubbles). To close from outside, send fx:close to the element

from.where: shared.css·shared.js .dz-hbg (white circle hamburger at 1024px and below — original open_line·close_line keyframes .25s linear 1 forwards, steps at 35%·65%)
